articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: FBI's fifth 'Most Wanted Fraudster' captured after alleged SNAP scam suspect arrested in India - Fox News
articles.description: Manjit Singh Bedi was arrested in India after allegedly fleeing the U.S. to escape SNAP benefits fraud charges tied to an alleged $600,000 EBT scheme.
